issues.explanation: Change adds prefixes, daily sequencing, factory, UpdateQueue and migrations with no Pest/PHPUnit tests, violating TDD no-production-code-without-test gate.
Next-code pattern uses (\d+) so 1-2 digit codes like N1 count as valid though task requires one letter plus at least 3 digits and malformed codes skipped.
Migration uses date change() to make issue_date non-nullable which needs doctrine/dbal and can fail on some drivers; portable raw SQL or table rebuild is safer.
Queue::defaultPrefixFor hardcodes N/P/E instead of reusing DEFAULT_PREFIX_MAP, duplicating the default mapping.
